note: Hints for hidden triggers (keyed by RAHiddenTriggers id) and rumour templates. Hints are vague on purpose: where, and a nudge on when or who, never the reward. Rumour tokens: {dir} compass direction, {dist} metres, {count} a number, {label} a threat label, {name} a place name.

fallen_shrine: The old ones say the Sleeping Flame only stirs for a child of eight. Its shrine lies toppled in the western wood, a long walk past the fields.
Eight is a lucky age in Ashford. Something in the western wood knows it, my gran used to say.
moonlit_pond: There's a still pond west of the fields that sings to little ones, but only late, after the inn has shut and the moon's up.
Children who can't sleep sometimes hear the pond past the western fields humming. Grown folk never do.
old_hunters_blind: Your father kept a hunting blind high in an oak east of here, years back. Go hunting with him and he might mention it.
There's a blind in the oaks east of the fields that nobody's climbed since your father was young.
burnt_watchtower: The burnt watchtower on the south-west ridge? Honest youngsters who climb it come down different. Thieves come down with nothing.
They say the ash on the south-west ridge remembers who's been good. Don't go up there with sticky fingers.

den: Wolves have been howling {dir} of the village. {count} of them at least, the shepherds reckon.
Old Hob lost a ewe to wolves out {dir}. The den's maybe {dist} paces off the road.
threat: People are saying: {label}. I'd keep to the road if I were you.
{label}, or so the Guard says. They don't say much else.
waystation: The Cinderpost Waystation keeps a lamp lit all night for travellers on the King's Ember Road.
Carts from Kingsreach stop at Cinderpost before they come on to us. That's where the news comes from.
hollow: Don't go near Whisper Hollow after dark. Kids who do come home with strange stories, if they come home at all.
Lights in the trees out past the western lake. The old folk call that place Whisper Hollow.
orcs: The Tuskridge orcs trade hides at the market twice a season. Chief Harrok keeps them in line, mostly.
Tuskridge Hold is south, past the Duskbriar. They're exiles, not raiders, whatever the Guard grumbles.
goblins: Mossfang goblins pinched a whole cartload of turnips last week. Turnips! What does a goblin want with turnips?
There's a goblin warren east, under the roots. Mossfang, they call themselves. Nasty little biters.
guild: The Guild's posted {count} commissions this week. Good coin for anyone handy with a blade.
Adventurers in and out of the Guild Hall all day. Something's stirring out there.
crown: The King's tax man is due before the Last Sheaf festival. Hide your good cider.
Princess Isolde rode through Millbrook with only four guards. Brave, or foolish.
